summary.text: Michael Clarkson is the Democratic candidate for Colorado House of Representatives District 45 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Max Brooks.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a veteran and technology professional who works as a cloud senior solutions architect.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Michael Clarkson said he is a veteran and technology professional who currently serves as a Cloud Senior Solutions Architect, specializing in cloud infrastructure, artificial intelligence integration and data center operations.

He said he has served as Chief of Security for Douglas County Pride and named his grandfather, Jerome J. Clarkson, a World War II veteran who later marched in the Civil Rights movement, as his primary role model.
Clarkson said his platform centers on economic growth, affordable housing, quality education and public safety.
He also said he would advocate for regulation of artificial intelligence, cryptocurrency and data centers.
